# LinkedIn Technical Marketing Post: Overdue Invoice Collection Radar

Cash-flow recovery system that categorizes accounts receivable into 30/60/90 day aging buckets, automatically dispatching polite-to-firm escalation sequences to recover unpaid revenue.

### The Problem
Most companies lose thousands in hidden operational waste every single month.

### The Engineered Fix
We engineered a zero-dependency system to solve this.

👉 Try the live interactive simulator here:
https://gideonbawa-website.netlify.app/simulators/invoice-collection-radar/
